svg.text: RST sits between GND and VCC:
second wire on the VCC pin, to the nice!view
The key module plugs into the socket board's sockets (its header side meets the socket side). The last key module needs the terminator module,
or a jumper from its J_LEFT2 pin 3 (DATA_IN) to J_LEFT1 pin 2 (+3.3V): without the 0xFF sentinel the chain reads as a fault and no keys fire.
Solder to the socket joints (J_LEFT), not the empty header pads: those reach the sockets through 0.25 mm tracks that a tugged wire breaks. Pad 1 is nearest the SW5 end.
